topic.geo-mesh-sdf.title: Per-mesh distance fields
topic.geo-mesh-sdf.summary: A distance field baked once per mesh in its own box: a narrow band, quantized, stored in sparse bricks, placed by the instance's transform
topic.geo-global-sdf.title: Merged distance-field clipmaps
topic.geo-global-sdf.summary: The scene's mesh fields merged into one coarse field in clipmaps around the camera, so a ray marches one volume, not every mesh
topic.rt-virtual-texturing.title: Virtual texturing and page tables
topic.rt-virtual-texturing.summary: A large texture kept as pages allocated on demand, found through a page table; only what is needed is resident
topic.rt-reprojection.title: Temporal reprojection
topic.rt-reprojection.summary: Motion vectors map a pixel to where it was last frame; the history there is reused, and rejected when it no longer matches
topic.rt-upscaling.title: Temporal upscaling
topic.rt-upscaling.summary: Rendering fewer pixels with a jitter each frame and accumulating them into a full-resolution image over time
topic.rt-hw-ray-tracing.title: Hardware ray tracing (BVH)
topic.rt-hw-ray-tracing.summary: Rays traced against triangles through a bounding volume hierarchy the GPU builds and traverses in fixed-function hardware
topic.rt-virtual-shadow-maps.title: Virtual shadow maps
topic.rt-virtual-shadow-maps.summary: Very large shadow maps stored as pages, rendered only where the view needs them and cached between frames
topic.rt-shadow-ray-marching.title: Soft shadows by marching shadow maps
topic.rt-shadow-ray-marching.summary: Rays toward points of an area light marched through a shadow map's depths, averaged into a soft penumbra
topic.gi-surface-cache.title: Surface caches in atlases
topic.gi-surface-cache.summary: Surfaces captured by small orthographic projections into atlas pages (albedo, normal, emissive, depth); a ray's hit finds its texel there instead of shading the mesh
topic.gi-radiosity.title: Radiosity in a surface cache
topic.gi-radiosity.summary: Probes on the cached surfaces gather the cache's own previous lighting, so each update adds a bounce; stored as spherical harmonics
topic.gi-screen-probes.title: Screen-space probe gather
topic.gi-screen-probes.summary: Probes placed on the depth buffer every few pixels, each tracing an octahedral set of rays, filtered with its neighbours and history, and interpolated per pixel
topic.gi-radiance-cache.title: World-space radiance caches
topic.gi-radiance-cache.summary: Probes in clipmapped grids around the camera that store incoming radiance, so long rays end early and read the far lighting there
topic.gi-glossy-tracing.title: Traced glossy reflections
topic.gi-glossy-tracing.summary: An importance-sampled GGX ray per pixel for smooth surfaces, screen-space first then in the scene, denoised; rough ones fall back to diffuse probes
